Scientific Integrity

Forensic Bug Postmortems (Bugs #6–#11)

Bug #6: Seed Leakage in Train/Val/Test Splits Fixed • Config-Seed Rule

Split strictly by configuration seed: row i belongs to test set iff seed i ≥ 850.

Bug #7: Label Leakage in Input Transforms Fixed • InputSpec v4

Standardized to universal 416-channel eV grid [0, 8.32 eV] computed without label knowledge.

Bug #8: Floating-Point Gap Leakage Fixed • Round-First (3 Decimals)

Round T to 3 decimal places before any division or logarithmic transform.

Bug #9: Corrupted Square Lattice Benchmarks Fixed • ca_sq.py Engine

Re-implemented via ca_sq.py with Sancho-Rubio decimation, achieving exact 10^-8 agreement.

Bug #10: Multi-Orbital TMD Disorder Decoupling Fixed • Atomic Defect Generator

Disorder generator picks physical Mo/W atom indices and shifts all 3 d-orbitals together with V = 0.2535 eV.

Bug #11: TMD N=14 Lead Decimation Mini-Gap Breakdown Fixed • Adaptive --lead-eta

Added configurable runtime --lead-eta = 1e-5 to resolve 0.9 meV mini-gap near band edges.
